newsitem.title: USA: Pillar Point, LaserSight enter settlement.
newsitem.headline: Pillar Point, LaserSight enter settlement.

text.p: VISX Inc said on Wednesday that Pillar Point Partners has agreed to settle patent infringment litigation against LaserSight Inc.
In the settlement, Pillar Point, VISX and Summit Technology Inc granted LaserSight a release from liability for the patent infringement claims.
LaserSight has agreed to make a nominal payment and to notify Pillar Point before it begins manufacturing or selling its laser vision correction products in the United States, VISX said.
Pillar Point is a partnership between VISX and Summit Technology that pays the companies for laser vision correction procedures that use the companies' products.
